mutants.label: historical-iso-c-trace

mutants.label: historical-diagonal-flags-on-a-non-diagonal-system

mutants.label: historical-r-group-takes-any-position

mutants.label: historical-r-cache-mismatch-accepted

mutants.decision: watched at the kind of R cache the evaluation reads: in DiagramIntegrand._require_r_indices_match and in the check of integrate_diagrams
